facial expressions: Babies learn a lot by watching the facial expressions of their parents, such as smiles and frowns.
嬰兒透過觀察父母的臉部表情，例如微笑和皺眉，學到很多東西。
facial features: The twins have the same facial features, so even their teachers cannot tell them apart.
這對雙胞胎五官一模一樣，連老師都分不出誰是誰。
facial recognition: My new phone uses facial recognition, so it unlocks as soon as it sees my face.
我的新手機使用人臉辨識，所以一看到我的臉就會解鎖。
a facial: Before her wedding, my sister went to a beauty salon to get a facial and have her nails done.
婚禮前，我姊姊去美容院做了臉部美容並修了指甲。
a faint hope: Although the boat had been missing for days, the family still held on to a faint hope that he was alive.
雖然船已失蹤好幾天，家人仍抱著一絲希望，相信他還活著。
a faint smile: Too tired to talk after the long trip, she just gave us a faint smile and went to bed.
長途旅行後累得說不出話，她只對我們露出淡淡的微笑就去睡了。
not have the faintest idea: I do not have the faintest idea where I put my keys; I've looked everywhere in the house.
我一點也不知道我把鑰匙放在哪裡，我已經找遍了整間房子。
a faint possibility: There is only a faint possibility of rain today, so you probably don't need an umbrella.
今天下雨的可能性很微小，所以你大概不需要帶傘。
feel faint: After standing in the hot sun for two hours without water, several students began to feel faint.
在大太陽下沒喝水站了兩個小時後，好幾個學生開始感覺快昏倒。
be faithful to the original: Fans were happy because the movie is faithful to the original novel and keeps all the main scenes.
影迷們很開心，因為這部電影忠於原著小說，保留了所有主要場景。
a faithful account: The soldier's diary gives a faithful account of daily life during the war, without hiding anything.
這名士兵的日記忠實地敘述了戰爭期間的日常生活，毫無隱瞞。
a faithful friend: My dog has been a faithful friend for ten years, always waiting for me at the door.
我的狗十年來一直是我忠誠的朋友，總是在門口等我。
remain faithful to one's principles: Even when he was offered a lot of money, the judge chose to remain faithful to his principles.
即使有人給他一大筆錢，這位法官仍選擇堅守原則。
fake news: Before sharing a shocking story online, check whether it comes from a real news site or is just fake news.
在網路上分享一則驚人的消息前，先查證它是來自真正的新聞網站還是只是假新聞。
a fake smile: The waiter greeted us with a fake smile, but it was clear he was annoyed by our late arrival.
服務生用假笑迎接我們，但顯然他對我們遲到感到不悅。
fake fur: Many fashion brands now use fake fur instead of real animal skin to protect wildlife.
許多時尚品牌現在改用人造毛皮，而非真的動物毛皮，以保護野生動物。
fake it: If you forget the dance steps on stage, just smile and fake it until the music ends.
如果你在台上忘了舞步，就微笑裝模作樣撐到音樂結束。
be familiar with the rules: Before the game starts, all players must be familiar with the rules, so please read them carefully.
比賽開始前，所有選手都必須熟悉規則，所以請仔細閱讀。
look familiar to me: That woman at the bus stop looks familiar to me; I think we went to the same high school.
公車站那位女士我覺得很眼熟，我想我們讀過同一所高中。
a familiar face: On my first day at the new school, I was so happy to see a familiar face from my old class.
到新學校的第一天，我非常高興看到一張舊班上熟悉的面孔。
be too familiar with: The new employee was told not to be too familiar with the customers, like calling them by nicknames.
新員工被告知不要對顧客過於親近隨便，例如用綽號稱呼他們。
a familiar sight: Scooters lined up at red lights are a familiar sight on the streets of Taipei every morning.
每天早上在台北街頭，等紅燈的一排排機車是常見的景象。
a fancy restaurant: For their anniversary, they had dinner at a fancy restaurant with candles, live music, and very high prices.
為了紀念日，他們在一家有燭光、現場音樂、價格也很高的高檔餐廳吃晚餐。
fancy dress: Everyone came to the Halloween party in fancy dress; I went as a pirate and my friend was a ghost.
大家都穿著變裝服來參加萬聖節派對，我扮成海盜，我朋友扮成鬼。
take a fancy to: My little sister took a fancy to the white kitten at the pet shop and begged Mom to buy it.
我妹妹喜歡上寵物店裡那隻白色小貓，求媽媽買給她。
nothing fancy: Dinner will be nothing fancy, just rice, soup, and some vegetables, so please come as you are.
晚餐沒什麼特別的，只是飯、湯和一些青菜，所以請輕鬆來就好。
fancy words: Good writing doesn't need fancy words; clear and simple sentences are often more powerful.
好的文章不需要華麗的辭藻，清楚簡單的句子往往更有力量。
Fancy that!: "Our old teacher just won the lottery and gave all the money to charity." "Fancy that! What a surprise!"
「我們以前的老師剛中了樂透，還把錢全捐給慈善機構。」「真想不到！太令人驚訝了！」
